recommendation.text: Run a 30-day zero-cash organic experiment around the personalized receipt reveal, optimizing retained contribution per creator-hour.
recommendation.status: Proposed plan; no publication, outreach, spending or product changes authorized
recommendation.evidence: Channel fit, hooks, targets and schedule are creative hypotheses, not validated demand or virality forecasts

positioning.description: Personalized receipt-shaped 4×16-inch satin photo print, with playful fictional everyday moments
positioning.posterRecommendation: Separate visually different Poster Edition promotion from main buying flow while retaining existing paid A3 URL; recommendation only
pendingOnly: Investigation of non-paper Zazzle formats; received during launch planning, deferred and not researched or implemented

channels.name: TikTok
channels.rationale: Test immediate visual surprise and personal recognition
channels.experiment: Six paired hook videos in first two weeks; four follow-ups, 12–20 seconds; counts are workload caps
channels.metric: Matched-age viewing/shares plus qualified visits, gift intent and retained contribution/hour
channels.constraint: Verify actual profile-link eligibility; use truthful preview footage

channels.name: Pinterest
channels.rationale: Test explicit gift-search intent with ordinary destination links
channels.experiment: Eight distinct linked Pins across four editions, then four informed follow-ups
channels.metric: Saves, qualified destination visits and attributable retained orders/hour
channels.constraint: No assumed Product rich Pin or catalog eligibility

channels.name: Reddit
channels.rationale: Obtain relevant design/maker discussion and comprehension feedback
channels.experiment: Read at most five communities; at most two original submissions where current rules permit
channels.metric: Useful discussion, gift intent and qualified visits per hour
channels.constraint: No community pre-approved; disclose maker role; link only where allowed

schedule.1: Check existing fictional-data mobile preview-to-Zazzle path; no purchase; inventory accounts/measurement/sample
schedule.2: Select real Standard/Sunshine output; capture base screen recording; write three hooks
schedule.3: Edit two videos and four distinct Pins; safe generic tracking if existing tools support it
schedule.5: Second Pin, community-rule reading, genuine comment replies
schedule.6: Second video and third Pin; prepare allowed maker post
schedule.7: Fourth Pin, optional permitted maker post, matched-age review

weeks.focus: Complete initial six videos/eight Pins; at most one additional suitable Reddit post
Repeat two strongest hooks; four new Pins and a genuine-question response video
Reconcile retained outcomes, time and actual earnings; choose one channel or pause

hooks.hook: Why did you frame a receipt?
A very small spoiler for your birthday.
hooks.execution: Label fictional future immediately; reveal real output

hooks.hook: I found your name in the tiny print.

hooks.execution: Show actual four editions; ask recipient preference

hooks.hook: This birthday card got unusually long.
hooks.execution: Reveal shape; identify receipt-shaped art print
Real everyday line → clearly staged ordinary moment

hooks.hook: Which line made you say “that’s me”?
hooks.execution: Voluntary favorite-line recognition; consent for real recipients

decisionRules: After two distinct creative rounds, pause a high-effort channel with no qualified visits or meaningful buyer intent; small samples remain inconclusive.
Watch/shares without visits: inspect actual link availability, CTA and gift positioning.
Previews without handoffs: inspect understanding/value; handoffs without confirmed orders: inspect delivered price, shipping and trust.
Scale time only when retained contribution/hour improves and actual payout economics are credible. No paid advertising recommendation.
Global upload cap 2/minute plus burst 4 can produce 429 on spikes; verify existing retry/failure behavior and monitor usage before concentrating distribution. Paid plans require new approval.
Recipient discomfort, privacy concern or perceived death prediction count as creative failures despite reach.
Use actual satin print proof before quality/unboxing/gifting claims; label mockups. No thermal-printer fulfillment implication or universal holiday delivery guarantee.
Share loop: preview/taste check → private enjoyment → optional favorite-line photo with identifiers covered → specific permission for any repost. No forced tagging or filming.

economicsAssumptions.status: Illustrative arithmetic, not verified payout or measured conversion
economicsAssumptions.selfPromotion: 40% combined total conditionally published; eligibility unconfirmed; never add 5%
economicsAssumptions.net: Marketing deductions, reversals, currency/tax/payout effects can lower retained earnings
economicsAssumptions.support: Artwork retention confirmed; commission answer pending; permitted full-URL follow-up just sent
economicsAssumptions.measurement: Separate aggregate arrivals, previews, uploads, outbound clicks, paid retained orders, retained royalties/referrals and settled payouts. Unknown attribution remains unknown.

definitions.contributionPerHour: Attributable retained creator earnings minus creator costs, divided by creator hours
definitions.outboundClick: Purchase-intent signal; not a paid order
